tasks.goal: Sum non-negative safe integer amountCents by nonempty string category. Preserve all string keys including __proto__ and constructor. Reject invalid rows and unsafe accumulated totals. Never mutate input.

Return new order records sorted lexically by id. Collapse exact repeated id/totalCents pairs; reject conflicting duplicates. Require nonempty string ids and non-negative safe integer totals. Do not mutate input.

Accept only plain objects with exactly id, quantity, unitCents. Normalize id by trimming; reject blank ids, coercion, extra keys, non-integers, quantity outside 1..1000, negative prices and unsafe multiplication. Return id, quantity, unitCents, totalCents. Do not mutate input.
